No Claude Code footer, Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer, and no claude.ai session link, in any commit, body or comment.
CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-rca-inert-closure-recording, at head 4c31eb16e5756579e1c951ff560bd3d7a8e39c4c. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: you are the root-cause seat (the brief below); read CLAUDE.md from main, and work in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 4c31eb16e5756579e1c951ff560bd3d7a8e39c4c for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-rca-inert-closure-recording, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-rca-inert-closure-recording <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-rca-inert-closure-recording; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Role: root-cause seat. Read dev/governance/roles/root-cause.md and dev/governance/rules/defect-root-cause.md from main, and follow them exactly. Topic: r10-rca-inert-closure-recording. You run beside PR #2662 (R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2, part b, branch fix/r10-ci-layout-p2b) and never inside it: do not edit that PR and do not push to its refs.

Defect class: edits to the INERT list (tests/closure.py) left tests/closures.json's recorded closures stale, so `tests / closures` went red or closures-autofix refused, three times in one PR family:
1. a0f525900: `tests / closures` red, INERT READS UNDER-APPROXIMATED.
2. #2656: closures-autofix refused its merge with skip-merge-failed (job 120356230438), because files on the INERT list were read.
3. d5b053e (probe B2, which contains #2662's code head 4a83592e3): `tests / closures` UNDER-SCOPED (job 120398407061). tests/harness_headers.py reads u5's run_part.py and unitcheck.py. They are listed only under inert_reads/harness_headers, not in its closure, after INERT_EXCEPT (9f7f443cc). closures-autofix (job 120411385621) printed "skip-classifier-disagrees -- THE REPAIR DID NOT HAPPEN".
The coordinator's account: `closure.py check` passed locally because it compared against CI artifact 12493224545, which was recorded before INERT_EXCEPT existed, so the check was vacuous. The detector it proposes is to freshly record, with the branch's own closure.py, each script that reads the moved files, then run check over those fresh recordings.

Owed, all four: (1) a named cause, reproduced at each instance's SHA, not taken from this brief; (2) one process state (a)-(d), with the quoted process line or check shown present or absent, obeyed or not (gate-scoping.md, ci-autofix.md, claim-files.md, CLAUDE.md rule 1 and closures-late-gate are relevant); (3) a class search, i.e. what else edits a classifier without re-recording, plus a cost test with measured numbers (instances, CI minutes per red, autofix refusals); (4) a countermeasure, or a recorded refusal. At 3 instances, the audit-class barrier (defect-root-cause.md) is owed: say what it must be (for example, prepr or closure.py refuses an INERT edit whose dependent scripts were not re-recorded at the head) and which group should own it. Never assert a number you did not measure. Never run a full derive_closures.sh off Linux (gate-scoping.md); `--single` on a Python script is allowed.

Return: write the Root cause section as a body file and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-rca-inert-closure-recording <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-rca-inert-closure-recording and is the return signal. Push code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-rca-inert-closure-recording only if your countermeasure is a check, test, lane or hook. Then demonstrate it failing on instance 3's tree and passing once fixed, plus a null control (an INERT edit with fresh recordings passes). Policy files are drafted and proposed, not landed. Rules: PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1; spare the GitHub API (bulk-list once, prefer git, stop on a 403); no Claude footers.
